svg.title: La Bella Tavola conversational assistant — pipeline illustration
svg.desc: Illustration: chat 'Book a table tomorrow' / 'Sure, for how many people?'. Voice in via Faster-Whisper, regex slot extraction and a finite-state machine, stage-specific prompts, Qwen via Ollama streamed over WebSockets, Chroma RAG and tools (CRM, menu, weather, SQLite), Piper TTS out.
svg.text: token stream over WebSockets → React UI
